name: Is it worth painting a rental property before selling?

mainEntity.name: Is it worth painting a rental property before selling?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, painting a rental property before selling is almost always a worthwhile investment. Rental properties often show more wear and tear than owner-occupied homes, making a fresh coat of paint essential to refresh the space, cover scuffs, and eliminate lingering odors. A clean, updated look can significantly improve a buyer's first impression, justify a higher asking price, and potentially shorten the time your property spends on the market. It demonstrates that the property has been well-maintained.
acceptedAnswer.description: Painting a rental property before selling is usually worthwhile to refresh the space, cover wear, and increase appeal and value for buyers.
